verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's Agent/Ask modes let users issue natural-language prompts to make code edits, refactor logic, and even assign tasks to Copilot from mobile (github-docs-1, github-docs-2, github-docs-4, github-docs-9, github-docs-13), demonstrating NL-driven operation of coding workflows. However, evidence covers only code-editing/agent tasks, not broader repo/administrative operations, and lacks independent hands-on corroboration of reliability for complex multi-step NL commands. Missing for 10: evidence of NL commands controlling non-coding GitHub features (issues, settings, CI/CD) and independent verification of agent-mode success rates.
